periods.description: The Royal Officer Academy regulates when students may draw Sword Devices and uses mock battles to test Drag-Knight ability, discipline, and status.
periods.principles: Students generally may not draw Sword Devices without permission except when catching criminals or facing danger; mock battles follow arena rules and rankings influence status.
periods.classification: class rules, duel rules, Knight Squadron admission criteria, official mock-battle records.
periods.origin: New Kingdom officer training policy after the coup.
limitations: rules bend under Lisha and Relie's political discretion
real Abyss emergencies override normal rules
